recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future changes, if any, should be handled in the Immunization Incubator IG source with PHER review rather than in this FHIR-core checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PHER issue asking to add ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.targetDisease, make recommendation.vaccineCode optional, and require each recommendation to include at least vaccineCode or targetDisease.
initial_application: Core source applied the change in commit ebec85a82e70b6dd6ca073cd464927b015d17fff by adding targetDisease and the imr-1 invariant, with commit 97be2c963f adding a target-disease-only example. Before removal, structuredefinition-ImmunizationRecommendation.xml carried imr-1, vaccineCode 0..*, and targetDisease 0..*.
additional_context: FHIR-17773 later made targetDisease repeatable for multi-disease vaccines, so the 0..* cardinality supersedes the original 0..1 proposal. Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from the active core build and changed surviving narrative links to the HL7 Immunization Incubator IG. The current external StructureDefinition has vaccineCode 0..*, targetDisease 0..*, and imr-1 requiring one of the two.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core source change was made because the active core build no longer owns ImmunizationRecommendation and the moved artifact already reflects the approved behavior.

related_jiras.note: Changed ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.targetDisease from 0..1 to 0..* and explains why the current repeatable cardinality should not be treated as incomplete application of FHIR-12484.
